environment.description: ECS Fargate service running in a public subnet with an Application Load Balancer forwarding traffic directly to the container on port 8080. The ALB listener has no WAF association. The service is registered in a public Route53 hosted zone. Security group allows inbound TCP/443 from 0.0.0.0/0 on the ALB and the ALB forwards to the target group. No authentication middleware is configured on the ALB or at the network layer.
